filename: The 2024 National List of Occupations in High Demand_A Technical Report.pdf

rows:
Replaced the previous CFE
with a survey, which was then
distributed via LinkedIn and the
DHET networks.

z The QLFS and CareerJunction data were analysed.
z A four-digit OFO-coded list was produced.
z An online survey was distributed to allow employers
to list occupations they will be recruiting for in the
future.
z The OIHD that were indicated by the survey sample
were manually mapped to their appropriate six-digit
OFO codes.
z The secondary data from the QLFS and
CareerJunction was combined with the survey data
to calculate overall demand scores.
